(ja)༄༅/ /rje btsun seng ge sgra'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya ba'i cho ga zla 'od gsar pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i

tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// rje btsun seng ge sgra'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya ba'i cho ga zla 'od gsar pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gzugs// skye 'gro'i nad gdon sdig sgrib sbyong mdzad pa'i// bla ma mchog dang dbyer med seng ge sgrar// gus pas btud nas de yi sbyin sreg brtsam// 'dir rje btsun seng ge sgra'i bsnyen pa rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya ba la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ sbyor ba thab ni sngar sa chog ma byas pa'i sa phyogs yin na gang du bya ba'i gnas su rang nyid lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas gtor ma cha gsum cho ga bzhin btang la dang po gnyis kyi phrin las bcol ba'i rjes su/ sa phyogs 'dir rje btsun seng ge sgra'i sbyin sreg gi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ lha mchod pa dang sems can gyi don bgyid par 'tshal na sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la stsal zhing sbyin sreg gi cho ga mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bar chad thams cad zhi ba'i stong grogs mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod de gshegs gsol sogs bya/ bgegs gtor gyi rjes su sa'i phyogs 'dir sogs gong ltar las 'tshal na zhes pa'i mthar 'byung po gdug pa can gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang ba rnams/ gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song shig ces dang*/ oṃ sarba bigh+nān gats+tsha/ na maḥs man+ta sogs khro bo'i sngags brjod cing rol mo bya/ gu gul gyis bdug yungs kar gyis phyogs kun du brabs pas bgegs thams cad byer bar bsams pa ni sa bslang ba'o// de nas lha'i nga rgyal brtan pos oṃ bhu khaṃ zhes brjod cing dkyil 'khor gyi sa phyogs thams cad lag pas bcags la sa phyogs nam mkha'i rang bzhin du bsam/ de bzhin du oṃ ha na ha na kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa ces mang du brjod pas sa phyogs skyon thams cad dang bral bar bsams pa ni sa sbyang ba'o// der zhi ba'i thab khung gi tshad spyi ltar thig btab pa brus pa'am/

brtsigs pa'am/ bris thab stabs gang bde lag len ltar bya/ thab kyi dbus su lha'i mtshan ma me tog tshom bu'am rdul tshon dkar po'i tshom bu dgod/ zhal 'jig rten pa'i nub tu phyogs pa'i dbang du byas/ bud shing ni/ tsher ma can ma yin pa 'o ma can gyi shing sor

yam shing gi tshad kyang 'di nyid do// brgyad pa yan chad khru gang tsam brtsig de ma 'byor na ba lang sogs kyi lci ba srog chags med pas thab kyi kha sgyer gyi steng nas zlum por brtsigs la nang gi shar lhor ting lo che ba zhig kyang gzhag go /me ni rdo dang lcags gtsubs pa las byung ba ma yin pa rgyun zhag gi me'am 'o ma can gtsubs pa sogs las byung ba'o// rdzas ni/ bsreg rdzas dang mchod rdzas dang gtor ma dang ku sha'i chun po la sogs pa 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad rnams gtsang zhing gya nom pa sta gon bya'o// bsham thabs ni/ thab kyi mtha' skor thams cad byi dor legs par byas la dri bzang gi chus byug thab kyi nub tu sgrub pa po'i stan nang tshangs can sogs shar du phyogs par bya/ mdun du rdor dril gyi bar du dgang gzar blugs kha sbyar la bzhag /dri bzang gi chu ku sha'i 'thor yab dang bcas pa dang*/ grub na thab dang sgrub pa po'i bar du 'jim pa las byas pa'i me yol dkar zhal gyis byugs par waṃ yig dkar po bris pa'ang bsham/ rang gi g.yon thab kyi g.yas nas chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod dang*/ 'phags pa dang me lha la zlum gtor re bsham/ rang gi g.yas thab kyi g.yon logs su rang ngos nas brtsams te/ yam shing mar til zas mchog dang*// 'bras dang so ba nas sran ma// gro dang dūrba ku sha rnams// lag len ji bzhin legs par bsham// ku sha'i chun po brgyad dang dpal 'bar rnams stabs gang bder gzhag yo byad thams cad dri bzang gis chus gtor te gzhag go /snga dro'i dus su rang nyid khrus byas/ 'byor na gos rgyan dkar pos brgyan la/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag nyid sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du sngags kyi lhag chad kha bskang zhing nus pa dbyung ba dang*/ sdig sgrib dang bar chad zhi ba'i phyir sbyin sreg gi cho ga la 'jug snyam pa'i bsam pa brtan pos sngar bshams pa'i stan la kha shar du bltas skyil krung ngam/

pus 'khyud dang bcas pa'i tsog pu rkang pa gnyis cung zad bsnol ba rig byed 'don pa lta bu'i spyod lam gyis 'dug go /dngos gzhi la bdag gi rnal 'byor ni/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs sam/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa lta bu rang stabs gang bde'i bdag bskyed bya/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga ma grub kyi bar la lag pa gnyis pus mo las phyir mi 'da' ba la bslab/ dpal 'bar la gong du bshad pa'i me sbar te lag pa gnyis gus pa'i tshul gyis thab la g.yas nas zlum por bskor zhing snying po lan gsum brjod la/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes brjod de/ thab kyi nang gi ting lo sbar la me gso/ de nas khu tshur bcangs pa'i mthe bong brkyang ba byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas dgang gzar blugs bzung la/ blugs gzar mar dang bcas pas dgang gzar gyi kha la reg cing zlum por g.yas skor gyi tshul gyis mar bud shing la khyab par blugs te/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la raṃ zhes brjod/ thab dang yo byad bsang ba ni/ rang lha'i nga rgyal gyis bsang chu la oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces nyer gcig la sogs pa bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs nas sngags de nyid brjod cing ku sha'i 'thor yab kyis thab dang yo byad rnams la gtor/ mchod rdzas dang bsreg rdzas rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi sngags rgyas bsang*/ swā bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ gzhan yang rol mo dang 'phan gdugs la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas rnams dang*/ yam shing la sogs pa'i bsreg rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa so so'i las sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan pa bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can sa dang nam mkha' bar snang thams cad khyab pa/

kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan par gyur/ zhes brjod la mchod rdzas rnams oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs nas shab+da'i bar rang rang gi sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab/ bsreg rdzas rnams mchod yon gyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hās yam shing*/ oṃ shrīṃ swā hās mar/ oṃ dz+riṃ swā hās 'bru/ oṃ swa swā hās rdzas thams cad bkru/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hās rdzas thams cad sbyangs/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣā swā hā/ zhes sogs rdzas sngags rnams kyis byin gyis brlab bo// thab swa bhā was stong par sbyangs la/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las byung ba'i zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ rgyar khru gang ba/ dpangs su khru phyed pa kha sgyer ram mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba/ phyi rol gyi grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa bris pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ thab kyi nang du raṃ las me dkar gsal du 'bar ba'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du raṃ las bgrang phreng raṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ me lha ra skyes dkar po la chibs pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas bgrang phreng*/ g.yon spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ lus po me'i rang bzhin dmar po/ zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dkar po las 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba/ gsus khyim che ba ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ sma ra dang smin ma dkar ser 'bar ba/ ag tshom 'phyang ba drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ bsam/ de'i thugs ka'i raṃ dang rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ shar lho nas me lha drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

zhes dang*/ lag pa gnyis kyi mthe bong gung mo'i rtser bzhag mdzub mos gung mo'i rgyab nas bkab pa dbyu gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya rna ba'i drung du g.yab cing*/ tshur spyon tshur spyon 'byung po che// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /bsreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// gzi brjid chen po me yi lha// 'dod pa thams cad sgrub pa po// thugs rjes sems can don mdzad pa// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// zhes pas spyan drangs dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs dam tshig pa la gnyis su med par bstim/ slar yang snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ de nas oṃ ag+ni sa pa ri wā ra zhes pa'i mtshan sngags re re'i 'gor sbyar ba'i chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal por ḍā kis dbang bskur ba// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsregs// 'jigs byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// ces pas bstod/ de nas ku sha'i chun po brgyad bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa thab dang yo byad rnams kyi 'bags pa dang ma dag pa thams cad sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par bsams te/ ku sha 'di ni bzang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /tshangs pa yi ni dag byed yin// dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de// des bdag la gegs med cing zhi bar mdzod cig

oṃ badz+ra satwa a zhes brjod cing thab kyi mdun nas g.yas skor gyi rim pas phyogs mtshams brgyad du dgram mo// de nas bsang chus phyogs kun tu gtor te a mṛ te brjod pas bgegs bsal lo// de nas gzar bu gnyis byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas bzung ste/ me lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs pa'i ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa la raṃ bsam/ dgang blugs gnyis kyi gzar bu'i kha la'ang raṃ bsams te/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes lan bdun brjod cing mar blugs gzar bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang la mthar/ oṃ ag+na ye a dī bya dī bya ma hā shrī ye ha bya ka bya bā ha nā ya swā hā/ zhes brjod de gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar te me lha'i zhal du phul/ de lta bu lan gsum gyis byon zan phul/ de nas bsreg rdzas rnams lag pa g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis blangs la mchog sbyin phyag rgyas dbul te/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣā ya swā hā/ yam shing*/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ mar/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+rā ya swā hā/ til lam yungs kar/ oṃ sarba saṃ ba de swā hā/ zho dang sbyar ba'i zas mchog oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hā/ 'bras/ oṃ badz+ra bi dza yā ya swā hā/ 'bras so ba/ oṃ ma hā be gā ya swā hā/ nas/ oṃ ma hā ba lā ya swā hā/ sran ma/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rā ya swā hā/ gro/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ dūrba/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+rā ya swā hā/ zhes pas ku sha rnams 'bul ba'am/ yang na sngags de rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs nas ag+na ye 'ba' zhig gis phul/ gang ltar yang nyer gcig la sogs pa ci 'byor pa'i mthar/ bdag dang sbyin bdag gis gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang*/ bar du gcod pa dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba gsang sngags kyi lhag chad la sogs pa'i nyes pa thams cad shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes las sngags spel tshig sde tshan re re'i mthar brjod do// de nas chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa dang bstod pa sngar ltar byas te/

mar dgang gzar gang thab tu blugs te badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐ zhes brjod la/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur par bsam mo// 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ me 'bar ba'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma dmar po sogs nas/ seng ge sgra la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje dril bu spos dang bcas pas/ ma lus sems can sogs nas/ yang dag 'khor dang bcas rnams gshegs su gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta singha nā da sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi zhes pas spyan drangs te/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i ar+ghaṃ sogs nas 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan zhes pa'i bar gyi yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed/ de'i mtha' skor du rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor bar gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsams la/ lha thams cad 'dzum zhing zhi ba 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba dang sdud pa'i sgo nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dang bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi ba'i las mdzad par bsams la/ de nas gzar bu gnyis blangs te lha thams cad kyi zhal cung zad gdangs pa sogs sngar ltar gsal btab ste/ oṃ āḥhrīḥsingha nā da hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes pa lan 'ga' zhig brjod pas mar la bsngags te/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes lan bdun gyis blugs gzar gyis mar blugs pas dgang gzar bkang la mthar/ oṃ ag+na ye a dī bya dī bya zhes sogs swā hā'i gong du bdag gis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i zhes sogs spel tshig gong ltar brjod de/ gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar la lha thams cad kyi zhal du dus gcig la phul bar bsam/ de lta bu lan gsum la sogs pas byon skyems phul/ de nas yo ga ltar mchod pa bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs nas/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho sogs nas oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta singha nā da sa pa ri wā ra sogs nas rol mo'i bar dang*/

spro na rgyal srid sna bdun 'dod yon lnga rnams kun rig ltar ro// bstod pa ni/ 'khor ba 'dzin rgyu chags bral zhing sogs kyi bstod pa rgyas pas bstod/ de nas yam shing nas brtsams te bsreg rdzas rnams sde tshan re re'i thog mar bo dhi bṛk+ṣā la sogs pa'i/ so so'i sngags gsum mam lnga la sogs pa dang mjug tu spel tshig gong ltar brjod cing brgya rtsa la sogs pa ji tsam 'byor pa 'bul/ rdzas thams cad snying po 'ba' zhig gis phul/ de nas til dkar nag mdun du 'dus byas la bdag gzhan gyi las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa til nag la thim/ dkar po la shes bya'i sgrib pa thim/ mar la de ma yin pa'i sgrib pa rnams thim zhes brjod cing bsams la/ snying po zlos shing phul bas sdig sgrib thams cad tshig nas bde ba chen po'i ngo bor bsam/ bsnyen pa kha skong la bsnyen pa ji tsam song ba'i bcu cha'i grangs 'bul dgos pas brgya phrag re'i mtshams su gong gi spel tshig sbyar te til 'ba' zhig dbul/ rdzas rnams kyi grangs dang yam shing dang mar ni me'i tshod dang sbyar te sgrub g.yog gis logs nas 'bul/ bsreg rdzas rnams rdzogs pa dang gong byon skyems kyi skabs su bshad pa ltar mar dgang blugs gsum 'bul/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos la byin gyis brlabs te/ mtshan sngags re re'i 'gor sbyar ba rol mo'i bar dang*/ bstod pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes sogs sam/ brtse ba'i thugs rje'i dbang phyug sogs gang rung gis bstod/ 'das pa'i gtor ma bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang*/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ a kā ro lan gsum/ mchod bstod bya/ rje btsun seng ge sgras bdag dang sbyin bdag gis gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/

klu dang sa bdag gis gnod pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag pa'i dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ zhes 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab bo// yig brgya ci nus dang ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// ces sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra muḥ zhes dang mtheb srin gyi se gol gyi sgras ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam/ srin lag gis thab kyi rdul cung zad blangs la dpral bar bskus te dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam mo// gsum pa rjes ni/ thab tu mar blugs gzar gang dgang gzar la reg pa dang bcas pas blugs la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ zhes brjod de/ me lha zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du gyur par bsams la/ bsreg rdzas rnams kyi lhag ma bdun nam bcu gcig gam nyer gcig la sogs pa ci 'byor pa phul/ mthar byon zan gyi skabs ltar mar dgang blugs gsum gang ba'i sbyin sreg tu phul/ me lha 'khor bcas la gtor ma gcig bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas byin gyis brlab/ lag pa g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya byas te/ oṃ ag+ni sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ zhes sogs gsum mam lngas phul/ mtshan sngags re re nas sngon du 'gro ba'i chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa dang*/ 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs dang*/ spro na tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras sogs kyis kyang bstod la/ drang srong chen po 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi bar du gcod pa thams cad dang sngags lhag chad kyi nyes pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes sogs 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/

yig brgya lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang*/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// byin za khyod kyis bsgrubs kyis gshegs// ji bzhin dus su slar gshegs te// bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs// oṃ ag+ni gats+tsha/ zhes dang*/ dbyu gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya phyir bskyed de/ me lha rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsams la/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po sogs kyis gnas gsum bsrung*/ dge ba 'di yis myur du sogs kyi smon lam ci shes dang*/ che ba'i che mchog sogs kyis bkra shis bya'o// mchog gi dngos grub sgrub pa yin na me ma shi'i bar du mi bsgul/ shi ba dang gzhan reg tu mi gzhug par rang gis phyags la thal ba 'dod pa rnams la'ang sbyin zhing lhag ma 'bab chu la sogs par dor/ thun mong gi dngos grub tsam la 'phral du phyags pas rung ngo*// thab kyi shul dang nye 'khor thams cad dri zhim po'i chus byugs te/ me tog la sogs pa gtor la bkra shis bya'o// de ltar rje btsun seng ge'i sgra'i// bsnyen pa mthar phyin rnal 'byor pas// sngags nus 'byin dang rang gzhan don// zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya tshul 'di// bris pa'i dge bas lus can kun// gdon gsum gnod pa las grol nas// tshogs rdzogs 'bras bu thams cad mkhyen// thob nas 'gro don lhun grub shog /ces rje btsun seng ge sgra'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya ba'i cho ga zla 'od gsar pa zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dge slong kun dga' chos 'phel gyi ngor ban+de tshul khrims rin gyis bris pa'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
